versions.changelog:
- Removed legacy mail script files: scripts/list_mail.sh, scripts/send_mail.sh, scripts/send_template_mail.sh
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) to reflect current available scripts and functionality
- No changes to core features or usage; cleanup of obsolete code and docs only

Initial release — provides AI agents with persistent memory storage and structured logging via AgentMM API.

- Supports creating, updating, searching, and soft-deleting structured memories (with tags, context, related keys).
- Offers comprehensive logging features: write/query logs, filter by level/category, view stats (error rate, level distribution, durations).
- All memory and log actions securely require the AGENTMM_API_KEY environment variable.
- Includes CLI scripts in the scripts/ directory for all supported operations.
- No credentials are stored in files; all communication uses HTTPS with bearer auth.
